title: Jeeva
desc: Jeeva, an unemployed youth, lives an ordinary life with his widowed mother and younger sister. His life turns upside down when his family gets murdered.

title: Manaivi Ready
desc: Radha, a young man, visits a village to attend the wedding of his friend's sister. However, when the groom runs away, he is forced to marry the devastated bride.

title: Ranuva Veeran
desc: Raghu returns to his village and learns that people are being terrorised by a notorious gang. His world comes crashing down when he realises that his sister is in love with the leader of the gang.

title: Pooveli
desc: When a man helps his classmate after the death of her lover, her family mistakes him for her husband. But the girl tries to make her family hate him so that he can go on with his life.

title: Panakkaran
desc: The illegitimate son of a rich man and a singer is raised by a poor drunkard. Before he can commit to the girl he loves, he wants to find out his biological parents.
